visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short dark hair stands in a doorway, holding a bowl of noodles and a spoon, speaking with exaggerated facial expressions. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of him eating the noodles and then showing a wallet, before he physically ducks down as if descending an escalator. (3) He transforms into a character with a blonde wig, black hat, and patterned gold jacket, holding a bottle of HeySong Sarsaparilla in an indoor living room setting. (4) The original character appears sitting inside a cardboard box on the floor, appearing distressed, and then drinks from a bottle handed to him. (5) A montage follows showing various drink products on a table and the blonde character performing energetic, rhythmic movements and gestures throughout the house. (6) Behind-the-scenes footage shows the character forgetting lines and laughing with off-screen crew members. (7) Close-ups of a bottle cap with '100' on it and promotional keychains are shown against a white background. (8) The video concludes with the character standing behind five different HeySong beverage bottles, posing energetically.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main male character performing multiple roles; 2 female crew members appearing briefly in behind-the-scenes segments.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian male with short black hair, wearing a black zip-up jacket with a '福' character embroidery and a cartoon patch, and light-colored sweatpants. He later wears a blonde wig, black fedora, and a gold/red brocade jacket.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The primary background is a modern indoor living space with white walls, wooden doors, storage boxes, shelves with books and figurines, and a cardboard box on the floor. Some shots show a studio-like setup with a plain white wall.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-pitched and loud male shouting begins, accompanied by high-tempo synth-pop music. The voice is strained and highly energetic. (2) A transition sound effect 'whoosh' signals a shift to a more rhythmic, almost sung delivery style over a consistent drum beat. (3) Background laughter from female voices is audible during the behind-the-scenes segments. (4) Distinct gulping and liquid swallowing sound effects are layered over the voice when the character is seen drinking. (5) The jingle reaches a crescendo with sharp percussion hits coinciding with visual prize announcements. (6) The video ends with a final enthusiastic shout and a musical stinger.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Problem -> Solution -> Promotion -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the HeySong 100th anniversary 'Million Dollar Fun' campaign. The video uses a comedic skit about inflation to segue into a promotional announcement for lottery prizes including a Lexus car and cash travel funds, aimed at encouraging consumers to purchase HeySong drinks and check bottle caps.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of products, mention of brand name '黑松' (HeySong), and detailed explanation of current promotional campaign prizes and methods.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video features popular creator 'Hook' using his signature high-energy comedic style. The production is characterized by rapid cuts and dense on-screen variety text typical of Taiwanese social media advertising.
